positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionBasis
positions.frame: what decision, rationale, and timeline together constitute the Zypherion adoption for the analytics pipeline?
positions.why: The document states the Zypherion adoption twice — once as prose (src-1/2/3) and once as a bullet-point summary (src-4/5/6) — and in both forms the same three facets recur together: the declarative choice of database, the performance rationale (15x columnar speedup), and the migration timeline (Q3 2026 start). Read directionally, these six expressions are not independent claims but restatements of one decision's basis from two vantage points (narrative recounting and structured summary); grouping them lets the decision, its justification, and its schedule be read as a single coherent unit rather than six scattered assertions.
